name: MAC flap WITH a coincident STP topology change: the MAC moves are a symptom of L2 reconvergence — prefer the STP signature
comment: C5 discriminator: a MAC flap concurrent with an STP topology change is downstream of the topology churn. The mac-flap discriminator fires (stp_topology_change present) and defers to sig.ent.access.stp-topology-change, which also absorbs the mac_flap as its optional storm witness and wins.
